verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the official Xero MCP server listing "Chart of Accounts management" as a capability, and the SDK description referencing general ledger accounting data. That shows chart-of-accounts administration exists, but nothing describes the customization depth the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented account types, sub-account or hierarchy support, class/tag (tracking category) dimensions, in-app first-party chart-of-accounts docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
